_comment: Data Compliance profiler tag rules (Cloudera Data Catalog, compute-cluster profilers) that apply the GDL_PII_* classifications automatically. scripts/profiler_rules.py renders the upload files under governance/profiler/ and checks the rules against the data. Score of a column = value_weight x share of its non-empty values matching any value regex + (100 - value_weight) if its name matches any name regex; the tag is applied at threshold or above. A low value_weight makes the column name decide (free text, or a format other columns share).

rules.name: GDL PAN
rules.description: Indian Permanent Account Number (AAAAA9999A), by value

rules.name: GDL Aadhaar
rules.description: Aadhaar number: 12 digits, optionally in groups of 4. Needs the name too: counterparty account numbers are 12 digits as well

rules.name: GDL Mobile
rules.description: Indian mobile number in the formats the source systems use (+91, 0 prefix, spaces, dashes)

rules.name: GDL Account number
rules.description: Bank account number (14 digits) in a column named for it. Name-led: account keys used in joins carry the same values and stay unmasked

rules.name: GDL Person name
rules.description: A person's name. Name-led: product, branch and rule names are text of the same shape

left_to_governance_py.dob: the mask depends on the column type (YEAR on a DATE, REDACT on a bronze string), which a tag rule cannot see; bronze cbs_customer.dob holds the same yyyy-MM-dd text as the silver DATE
left_to_governance_py.views: the profilers profile tables; the semantic views keep the classifications governance.py applies
